items.name: Effort Reporting Compliance Extraction
items.description: Uploads a federal award notice or agreement and returns a single structured JSON object covering effort-reporting and personnel-compliance requirements: cadence, certification method, PI commitments, per-person key-personnel commitments, cost-shared effort, governing regulation, record-retention requirement, and referenced governing documents. Output conforms to the effort-reporting-extraction-udm component schema. The runtime mirrors the ui-insight/ProcessMapping effort-reporting-extraction workflow (one Extraction task plus a Formatting/Consolidation task).

data.name: extract-effort-compliance
data.prompt:
You are extracting effort-reporting and personnel-compliance
requirements from a federal award document.

Be 100% accurate. For each searchset item, return the value as
the document states it. Quote effort percentages, person-months,
and day-counts verbatim ("2.0 summer months", "25%", "30 days").
Use null when a field is not present — never invent values.

Search the entire document with attention to sections titled
"Effort Reporting", "Time and Effort", "Personnel", "Key
Personnel", "Budget Justification", or "Research Terms and
Conditions". Keywords to follow: effort reporting, time and
effort, personnel, key personnel, salary, certification, 2 CFR
200.430, cost share effort, person-months, summer months, FATC,
RTC, principal investigator, co-principal investigator.

For reporting_frequency return one of: Monthly, Quarterly,
Semi-Annual, Annual. For certification_method return one of:
After-the-Fact, Plan-Confirmation, Payroll-Based.

key_personnel_commitments is a JSON array; one row per named
individual with role, committed_effort, person_months, and any
cost_shared_effort. The PI's row should mirror the
pi_committed_effort scalar exactly.

referenced_documents is for governing instruments only (RTCs,
CA-FATC, NSF PAPPG, NIH GPS) — not for cited regulations
(governing_regulation).

items.searchphrase: Federal Award Identification Number printed on the award.
items.title: award_number

items.searchphrase: Full project title as stated in the award.
items.title: project_title

items.searchphrase: Cadence at which effort must be certified (Monthly, Quarterly, Semi-Annual, Annual).
items.title: reporting_frequency

items.searchphrase: Deadline for effort certification after each reporting period end.
items.title: certification_deadline

items.searchphrase: Effort certification method per 2 CFR 200.430(i) (After-the-Fact, Plan-Confirmation, Payroll-Based).
items.title: certification_method

items.searchphrase: PI committed effort using the sponsor's exact phrasing (e.g., "2.0 summer months", "25% academic year").
items.title: pi_committed_effort

items.searchphrase: PI committed effort expressed as person-months when the document provides it.
items.title: pi_person_months

items.searchphrase: JSON array of {name, role, committed_effort, person_months, cost_shared_effort, notes}, one row per named individual.
items.title: key_personnel_commitments

items.searchphrase: Total cost-shared effort obligations across the award, when separately documented.
items.title: cost_shared_effort

items.searchphrase: Record retention period requirement (e.g., "3 years", "per sponsor requirements").
items.title: record_retention

items.searchphrase: Referenced governing documents (RTCs, CA-FATC, agency policy statements). Empty array when none are stated.
items.title: referenced_documents

data.name: effort-compliance-consolidation
data.prompt:
You are assembling the Effort Reporting Compliance Extraction
output. The input is the JSON fragment produced by the upstream
Extraction task. Your job is to emit a single JSON object that
validates against the effort-reporting-extraction-udm@0.1.0
schema.

Rules:
1. Map each Extraction searchset item to the corresponding
   top-level schema field.
2. reporting_frequency and certification_method must use the
   enum values exactly. Normalize document phrasings to the
   closest enum; null when not specified.
3. pi_committed_effort is required. Use the sponsor's exact
   phrasing.
4. key_personnel_commitments is required and must contain at
   least one row. Ensure the PI is represented and that their
   row mirrors pi_committed_effort and pi_person_months
   exactly.
5. referenced_documents is a flat list of governing-instrument
   names; cited regulations belong in governing_regulation.
6. Use null for missing scalar fields; never invent values.
7. Do not output any text outside the single JSON object.

validation_plan.check_description: When effort is expressed as percentages across multiple months/periods, the sum should equal the document's stated total commitment.
pi_person_months should match the PI's row in key_personnel_commitments and be derivable from pi_committed_effort.
Every named individual in the document with a committed effort should appear in key_personnel_commitments (including the PI).
